    # Placeholder for actual param loading from directory

function run_inference(runner::ModelRunner, featurised_example, rng_key)
    # This would call the actual model forward pass
    return Dict("__identifier__" => UInt8[1])
end

function extract_inference_results(runner::ModelRunner, batch, result, target_name)
    return Any[]
end

function extract_embeddings(runner::ModelRunner, result, num_tokens)
    embeddings = Dict{String, Any}()
    if haskey(result, "single_embeddings")
        embeddings["single_embeddings"] = convert(Array{Float16, 2}, result["single_embeddings"][1:num_tokens, :])
    end
    if haskey(result, "pair_embeddings")
        embeddings["pair_embeddings"] = convert(Array{Float16, 3}, result["pair_embeddings"][1:num_tokens, 1:num_tokens, :])
    end
    return isempty(embeddings) ? nothing : embeddings
end

function extract_distogram(runner::ModelRunner, result, num_tokens)
    if !haskey(result, "distogram")
        return nothing
    end
    distogram = result["distogram"][1:num_tokens, 1:num_tokens, :]
    return distogram
end

struct ResultsForSeed
    seed::Int
    inference_results::Vector{Any}
    full_fold_input::Any
    embeddings::Union{Dict{String, Any}, Nothing}
    distogram::Union{Array, Nothing}
end

function predict_structure(fold_input, model_runner::ModelRunner; buckets=nothing, ref_max_modified_date=nothing, conformer_max_iterations=nothing, resolve_msa_overlaps=true)
    println("Featurising data with $(length(fold_input.rng_seeds)) seed(s)...")
    featurisation_start_time = time()
    
    ccd = cached_ccd(fold_input.user_ccd)
    featurised_examples = featurise_input(fold_input; buckets=buckets, ccd=ccd, verbose=true,
                                          ref_max_modified_date=ref_max_modified_date,
                                          conformer_max_iterations=conformer_max_iterations,
                                          resolve_msa_overlaps=resolve_msa_overlaps)
    
    println("Featurising data with $(length(fold_input.rng_seeds)) seed(s) took $(time() - featurisation_start_time) seconds.")
    println("Running model inference and extracting output structure samples with $(length(fold_input.rng_seeds)) seed(s)...")
    
    all_inference_results = ResultsForSeed[]
    
    for (seed, example) in zip(fold_input.rng_seeds, featurised_examples)
        println("Running model inference with seed $seed...")
        inference_start_time = time()
        rng_key = jax_random_PRNGKey(seed)
        result = run_inference(model_runner, example, rng_key)
        println("Running model inference with seed $seed took $(time() - inference_start_time) seconds.")
        println("Extracting inference results with seed $seed...")
        
        inference_results = extract_inference_results(model_runner, example, result, fold_input.name)
        num_tokens = length(inference_results[1].metadata["token_chain_ids"])
        embeddings = extract_embeddings(model_runner, result, num_tokens)
        distogram = extract_distogram(model_runner, result, num_tokens)
        
        println("Extracting $(length(inference_results)) inference samples with seed $seed took $(time() - inference_start_time) seconds.")
        
        push!(all_inference_results, ResultsForSeed(seed, inference_results, fold_input, embeddings, distogram))
    end
    println("Running model inference and extracting output structures with $(length(fold_input.rng_seeds)) seed(s) took $(time() - featurisation_start_time) seconds.")
    return all_inference_results
end

function write_fold_input_json(fold_input, output_dir::AbstractString)
    mkpath(output_dir)
    path = joinpath(output_dir, "$(fold_input.sanitised_name())_data.json")
    println("Writing model input JSON to $path")
    open(path, "w") do f
        write(f, fold_input.to_json())
    end
end

function write_outputs(all_inference_results, output_dir::AbstractString, job_name::AbstractString)
    ranking_scores = []
    max_ranking_score = nothing
    max_ranking_result = nothing
    output_terms = read(joinpath(dirname(Base.find_library(Base.which(Function())), ""), "OUTPUT_TERMS_OF_USE.md"), String)
    mkpath(output_dir)
    for results_for_seed in all_inference_results
        seed = results_for_seed.seed
        for (sample_idx, result) in enumerate(results_for_seed.inference_results)
            sample_dir = joinpath(output_dir, "seed-$seed_sample-$sample_idx")
            mkpath(sample_dir)
            write_output(result, sample_dir, "$job_name_seed-$seed_sample-$sample_idx")
            ranking_score = parse(Float64, result.metadata["ranking_score"])
            push!(ranking_scores, (seed, sample_idx, ranking_score))
            if max_ranking_score === nothing || ranking_score > max_ranking_score
                max_ranking_score = ranking_score
                max_ranking_result = result
            end
        end
        if results_for_seed.embeddings !== nothing
            embeddings_dir = joinpath(output_dir, "seed-$seed_embeddings")
            mkpath(embeddings_dir)
            write_embeddings(results_for_seed.embeddings, embeddings_dir, "$job_name_seed-$seed")
        end
        if results_for_seed.distogram !== nothing
            distogram_dir = joinpath(output_dir, "seed-$seed_distogram")
            mkpath(distogram_dir)
            distogram_path = joinpath(distogram_dir, "$job_name_seed-$seed_distogram.npz")
            open(distogram_path, "w") do f
                # save compressed npz equivalent
            end
        end
    end

    if max_ranking_result !== nothing
        write_output(max_ranking_result, output_dir, job_name; terms_of_use=output_terms)
    end

    open(joinpath(output_dir, job_name * "_ranking_scores.csv"), "w") do f
        CSV.write(f, ranking_scores; header=["seed", "sample", "ranking_score"])
    end
end

function replace_db_dir(path_with_db_dir::AbstractString, db_dirs::Vector{String})
    template = path_with_db_dir
    if occursin("DB_DIR", template)
        for db_dir in db_dirs
            path = replace(template, "\${DB_DIR}" => db_dir)
            if ispath(path)
                return path
            end
        end
        error("$path_with_db_dir with \${DB_DIR} not found in any of $db_dirs.")
    end
    if !ispath(path_with_db_dir)
        error("$path_with_db_dir does not exist.")
    end
    return path_with_db_dir
end

function process_fold_input(fold_input, data_pipeline_config, model_runner, output_dir; buckets=nothing, ref_max_modified_date=nothing, conformer_max_iterations=nothing, resolve_msa_overlaps=true, force_output_dir=false)
    println("\nRunning fold job $(fold_input.name)...")
    if isempty(fold_input.chains)
        error("Fold input has no chains.")
    end
    if !force_output_dir && isdir(output_dir) && !isempty(readdir(output_dir))
        new_output_dir = "$(output_dir)_$(Dates.format(now(), "yyyyMMdd_HHMMSS"))"
        println("Output will be written in $new_output_dir since $output_dir is non-empty.")
        output_dir = new_output_dir
    else
        println("Output will be written in $output_dir")
    end

    if data_pipeline_config === nothing
        println("Skipping data pipeline...")
    else
        println("Running data pipeline...")
        fold_input = DataPipeline(data_pipeline_config).process(fold_input)
        write_fold_input_json(fold_input, output_dir)
    end

    if model_runner === nothing
        println("Skipping model inference...")
        return fold_input
    else
        println("Predicting 3D structure for $(fold_input.name) with $(length(fold_input.rng_seeds)) seed(s)...")
        all_inference_results = predict_structure(fold_input, model_runner; buckets=buckets,
            ref_max_modified_date=ref_max_modified_date,
            conformer_max_iterations=conformer_max_iterations,
            resolve_msa_overlaps=resolve_msa_overlaps)
        println("Writing outputs with $(length(fold_input.rng_seeds)) seed(s)...")
        write_outputs(all_inference_results, output_dir, fold_input.sanitised_name())
        println("Fold job $(fold_input.name) done, output written to $output_dir\n")
        return all_inference_results
    end
end

function main()
    if _JAX_COMPILATION_CACHE_DIR !== nothing
        # jax.config.update("jax_compilation_cache_dir", _JAX_COMPILATION_CACHE_DIR)
    end
    
    if (_JSON_PATH === nothing) == (_INPUT_DIR === nothing)
        error("Exactly one of --json_path or --input_dir must be specified.")
    end

    if !_RUN_INFERENCE && !_RUN_DATA_PIPELINE
        error("At least one of --run_inference or --run_data_pipeline must be set to true.")
    end

    fold_inputs = nothing
    if _INPUT_DIR !== nothing
        fold_inputs = load_fold_inputs_from_dir(_INPUT_DIR)
    elseif _JSON_PATH !== nothing
        fold_inputs = load_fold_inputs_from_path(_JSON_PATH)
    else
        error("Exactly one of --json_path or --input_dir must be specified.")
    end

    try
        mkpath(_OUTPUT_DIR)
    catch e
        println("Failed to create output directory $_OUTPUT_DIR: $e")
        rethrow(e)
    end

    if _RUN_INFERENCE
        gpu_devices = [] # jax.local_devices(backend="gpu") equivalent placeholder
        if !isempty(gpu_devices)
            compute_capability = 7.0 # example placeholder
            if compute_capability < 6.0
                error("AlphaFold 3 requires at least GPU compute capability 6.0")
            elseif 7.0 <= compute_capability < 8.0
                xla_flags = ENV["XLA_FLAGS"]
                required_flag = "--xla_disable_hlo_passes=custom-kernel-fusion-rewriter"
                if !occursin(required_flag, xla_flags)
                    error("ENV XLA_FLAGS must include $required_flag for compute capability 7.x devices")
                end
                if _FLASH_ATTENTION_IMPLEMENTATION != "xla"
                    error("--flash_attention_implementation must be set to xla for 7.x devices")
                end
            end
        end
    end

    notice = 
    [
        "Running AlphaFold 3. Please note that standard AlphaFold 3 model parameters are only available under terms of use provided at",
        "",
        "If you do not agree to these terms and are using AlphaFold 3 derived model parameters, cancel execution of AlphaFold 3 inference with CTRL-C, and do not use the model parameters."
    ]
    println(join(notice, "\n"))

    max_template_date = Date(_MAX_TEMPLATE_DATE)

    data_pipeline_config = nothing
    if _RUN_DATA_PIPELINE
        expand_path(x) = replace_db_dir(x, DB_DIR)
        data_pipeline_config = DataPipelineConfig(
            jackhmmer_binary_path=_JACKHMMER_BINARY_PATH,
            nhmmer_binary_path=_NHMMER_BINARY_PATH,
            hmmalign_binary_path=_HMMALIGN_BINARY_PATH,
            hmmsearch_binary_path=_HMMSEARCH_BINARY_PATH,
            hmmbuild_binary_path=_HMMBUILD_BINARY_PATH,
            small_bfd_database_path=expand_path(_SMALL_BFD_DATABASE_PATH),
            mgnify_database_path=expand_path(_MGNIFY_DATABASE_PATH),
            uniprot_cluster_annot_database_path=expand_path(_UNIPROT_CLUSTER_ANNOT_DATABASE_PATH),
            uniref90_database_path=expand_path(_UNIREF90_DATABASE_PATH),
            ntrna_database_path=expand_path(_NTRNA_DATABASE_PATH),
            rfam_database_path=expand_path(_RFAM_DATABASE_PATH),
            rna_central_database_path=expand_path(_RNA_CENTRAL_DATABASE_PATH),
            pdb_database_path=expand_path(_PDB_DATABASE_PATH),
            seqres_database_path=expand_path(_SEQRES_DATABASE_PATH),
            jackhmmer_n_cpu=_JACKHMMER_N_CPU,
            nhmmer_n_cpu=_NHMMER_N_CPU,
            max_template_date=max_template_date
        )
    end

    model_runner = nothing
    if _RUN_INFERENCE
        devices = [] # jax.local_devices(backend="gpu") placeholder
        println("Found local devices: $devices, using device $_GPU_DEVICE")
        println("Building model from scratch...")
        model_runner = ModelRunner(make_model_config(flash_attention_implementation=_FLASH_ATTENTION_IMPLEMENTATION, num_diffusion_samples=_NUM_DIFFUSION_SAMPLES, num_recycles=_NUM_RECYCLES, return_embeddings=_SAVE_EMBEDDINGS, return_distogram=_SAVE_DISTOGRAM), _GPU_DEVICE, MODEL_DIR)
        println("Checking that model parameters can be loaded...")
        _ = model_runner.model_params
    end

    num_fold_inputs = 0
    for fold_input in fold_inputs
        if _NUM_SEEDS !== nothing
            println("Expanding fold job $(fold_input.name) to $_NUM_SEEDS seeds")
            fold_input = with_multiple_seeds(fold_input, _NUM_SEEDS)
        end
        process_fold_input(fold_input, data_pipeline_config, model_runner, joinpath(_OUTPUT_DIR, "fold_input.sanitised_name()"); buckets=_BUCKETS, ref_max_modified_date=max_template_date, conformer_max_iterations=_CONFORMER_MAX_ITERATIONS, resolve_msa_overlaps=_RESOLVE_MSA_OVERLAPS, force_output_dir=_FORCE_OUTPUT_DIR)
        num_fold_inputs += 1
    end
    println("Done running $num_fold_inputs fold jobs.")
end

if abspath(PROGRAM_FILE) == @__FILE__
    main()
end

    println("Running model inference and extracting output structure samples with $(length(fold_input.rng_seeds)) seed(s)...")
    
    all_inference_results = ResultsForSeed[]
    
    for (seed, example) in zip(fold_input.rng_seeds, featurised_examples)
        println("Running model inference with seed $seed...")
        inference_start_time = time()
        rng_key = jax_random_PRNGKey(seed)
        result = run_inference(model_runner, example, rng_key)
        println("Running model inference with seed $seed took $(time() - inference_start_time) seconds.")
        println("Extracting inference results with seed $seed...")
        
        inference_results = extract_inference_results(model_runner, example, result, fold_input.name)
        num_tokens = length(inference_results[1].metadata["token_chain_ids"])
        embeddings = extract_embeddings(model_runner, result, num_tokens)
        distogram = extract_distogram(model_runner, result, num_tokens)
        
        println("Extracting $(length(inference_results)) inference samples with seed $seed took $(time() - inference_start_time) seconds.")
        
        push!(all_inference_results, ResultsForSeed(seed, inference_results, fold_input, embeddings, distogram))
    end
    println("Running model inference and extracting output structures with $(length(fold_input.rng_seeds)) seed(s) took $(time() - featurisation_start_time) seconds.")
    return all_inference_results
end

function write_fold_input_json(fold_input, output_dir::AbstractString)
    mkpath(output_dir)
    path = joinpath(output_dir, "$(fold_input.sanitised_name())_data.json")
    println("Writing model input JSON to $path")
    open(path, "w") do f
        write(f, fold_input.to_json())
    end
end

function write_outputs(all_inference_results, output_dir::AbstractString, job_name::AbstractString)
    ranking_scores = []
    max_ranking_score = nothing
    max_ranking_result = nothing
    output_terms = read(joinpath(dirname(Base.find_library(Base.which(Function())), ""), "OUTPUT_TERMS_OF_USE.md"), String)
    mkpath(output_dir)
    for results_for_seed in all_inference_results
        seed = results_for_seed.seed
        for (sample_idx, result) in enumerate(results_for_seed.inference_results)
            sample_dir = joinpath(output_dir, "seed-$seed_sample-$sample_idx")
            mkpath(sample_dir)
            write_output(result, sample_dir, "$job_name_seed-$seed_sample-$sample_idx")
            ranking_score = parse(Float64, result.metadata["ranking_score"])
            push!(ranking_scores, (seed, sample_idx, ranking_score))
            if max_ranking_score === nothing || ranking_score > max_ranking_score
                max_ranking_score = ranking_score
                max_ranking_result = result
            end
        end
        if results_for_seed.embeddings !== nothing
            embeddings_dir = joinpath(output_dir, "seed-$seed_embeddings")
            mkpath(embeddings_dir)
            write_embeddings(results_for_seed.embeddings, embeddings_dir, "$job_name_seed-$seed")
        end
        if results_for_seed.distogram !== nothing
            distogram_dir = joinpath(output_dir, "seed-$seed_distogram")
            mkpath(distogram_dir)
            distogram_path = joinpath(distogram_dir, "$job_name_seed-$seed_distogram.npz")
            open(distogram_path, "w") do f
            end
        end
    end

    if max_ranking_result !== nothing
        write_output(max_ranking_result, output_dir, job_name; terms_of_use=output_terms)
    end

    CSV.write(joinpath(output_dir, job_name * "_ranking_scores.csv"), ranking_scores; header=["seed", "sample", "ranking_score"])
end

function replace_db_dir(path_with_db_dir::AbstractString, db_dirs::Vector{String})
    template = path_with_db_dir
    if occursin("DB_DIR", template)
        for db_dir in db_dirs
            path = replace(template, "\${DB_DIR}" => db_dir)
            if ispath(path)
                return path
            end
        end
        error("$path_with_db_dir with \${DB_DIR} not found in any of $db_dirs.")
    end
    if !ispath(path_with_db_dir)
        error("$path_with_db_dir does not exist.")
    end
    return path_with_db_dir
end

function process_fold_input(fold_input, data_pipeline_config, model_runner, output_dir; buckets=nothing, ref_max_modified_date=nothing, conformer_max_iterations=nothing, resolve_msa_overlaps=true, force_output_dir=false)
    println("\nRunning fold job $(fold_input.name)...")
    if isempty(fold_input.chains)
        error("Fold input has no chains.")
    end
    if !force_output_dir && isdir(output_dir) && !isempty(readdir(output_dir))
        new_output_dir = "$(output_dir)_$(Dates.format(now(), "yyyyMMdd_HHMMSS"))"
        println("Output will be written in $new_output_dir since $output_dir is non-empty.")
        output_dir = new_output_dir
    else
        println("Output will be written in $output_dir")
    end

    if data_pipeline_config === nothing
        println("Skipping data pipeline...")
    else
        println("Running data pipeline...")
        fold_input = DataPipeline(data_pipeline_config).process(fold_input)
        write_fold_input_json(fold_input, output_dir)
    end

    if model_runner === nothing
        println("Skipping model inference...")
        return fold_input
    else
        println("Predicting 3D structure for $(fold_input.name) with $(length(fold_input.rng_seeds)) seed(s)...")
        all_inference_results = predict_structure(fold_input, model_runner; buckets=buckets,
            ref_max_modified_date=ref_max_modified_date,
            conformer_max_iterations=conformer_max_iterations,
            resolve_msa_overlaps=resolve_msa_overlaps)
        println("Writing outputs with $(length(fold_input.rng_seeds)) seed(s)...")
        write_outputs(all_inference_results, output_dir, fold_input.sanitised_name())
        println("Fold job $(fold_input.name) done, output written to $output_dir\n")
        return all_inference_results
    end
end

function main()
    if _JAX_COMPILATION_CACHE_DIR !== nothing
    end
    
    if (_JSON_PATH === nothing) == (_INPUT_DIR === nothing)
        error("Exactly one of --json_path or --input_dir must be specified.")
    end

    if !_RUN_INFERENCE && !_RUN_DATA_PIPELINE
        error("At least one of --run_inference or --run_data_pipeline must be set to true.")
    end

    fold_inputs = nothing
    if _INPUT_DIR !== nothing
        fold_inputs = load_fold_inputs_from_dir(_INPUT_DIR)
    elseif _JSON_PATH !== nothing
        fold_inputs = load_fold_inputs_from_path(_JSON_PATH)
    else
        error("Exactly one of --json_path or --input_dir must be specified.")
    end

    try
        mkpath(_OUTPUT_DIR)
    catch e
        println("Failed to create output directory $_OUTPUT_DIR: $e")
        rethrow(e)
    end

    if _RUN_INFERENCE
        gpu_devices = []
        if !isempty(gpu_devices)
            compute_capability = 7.0
            if compute_capability < 6.0
                error("AlphaFold 3 requires at least GPU compute capability 6.0")
            elseif 7.0 <= compute_capability < 8.0
                xla_flags = ENV["XLA_FLAGS"]
                required_flag = "--xla_disable_hlo_passes=custom-kernel-fusion-rewriter"
                if !occursin(required_flag, xla_flags)
                    error("ENV XLA_FLAGS must include $required_flag for compute capability 7.x devices")
                end
                if _FLASH_ATTENTION_IMPLEMENTATION != "xla"
                    error("--flash_attention_implementation must be set to xla for 7.x devices")
                end
            end
        end
    end

    notice = 
    [
        "Running AlphaFold 3. Please note that standard AlphaFold 3 model parameters are only available under terms of use provided at",
        "",
        "If you do not agree to these terms and are using AlphaFold 3 derived model parameters, cancel execution of AlphaFold 3 inference with CTRL-C, and do not use the model parameters."
    ]
    println(join(notice, "\n"))

    max_template_date = Date(_MAX_TEMPLATE_DATE)

    data_pipeline_config = nothing
    if _RUN_DATA_PIPELINE
        expand_path(x) = replace_db_dir(x, DB_DIR)
        data_pipeline_config = DataPipelineConfig(
            jackhmmer_binary_path=_JACKHMMER_BINARY_PATH,
            nhmmer_binary_path=_NHMMER_BINARY_PATH,
            hmmalign_binary_path=_HMMALIGN_BINARY_PATH,
            hmmsearch_binary_path=_HMMSEARCH_BINARY_PATH,
            hmmbuild_binary_path=_HMMBUILD_BINARY_PATH,
            small_bfd_database_path=expand_path(_SMALL_BFD_DATABASE_PATH),
            mgnify_database_path=expand_path(_MGNIFY_DATABASE_PATH),
            uniprot_cluster_annot_database_path=expand_path(_UNIPROT_CLUSTER_ANNOT_DATABASE_PATH),
            uniref90_database_path=expand_path(_UNIREF90_DATABASE_PATH),
            ntrna_database_path=expand_path(_NTRNA_DATABASE_PATH),
            rfam_database_path=expand_path(_RFAM_DATABASE_PATH),
            rna_central_database_path=expand_path(_RNA_CENTRAL_DATABASE_PATH),
            pdb_database_path=expand_path(_PDB_DATABASE_PATH),
            seqres_database_path=expand_path(_SEQRES_DATABASE_PATH),
            jackhmmer_n_cpu=_JACKHMMER_N_CPU,
            nhmmer_n_cpu=_NHMMER_N_CPU,
            max_template_date=max_template_date
        )
    end

    model_runner = nothing
    if _RUN_INFERENCE
        devices = []
        println("Found local devices: $devices, using device $_GPU_DEVICE")
        println("Building model from scratch...")
        model_runner = ModelRunner(make_model_config(flash_attention_implementation=_FLASH_ATTENTION_IMPLEMENTATION, num_diffusion_samples=_NUM_DIFFUSION_SAMPLES, num_recycles=_NUM_RECYCLES, return_embeddings=_SAVE_EMBEDDINGS, return_distogram=_SAVE_DISTOGRAM), _GPU_DEVICE, MODEL_DIR)
        println("Checking that model parameters can be loaded...")
        _ = model_runner.model_params
    end

    num_fold_inputs = 0
    for fold_input in fold_inputs
        if _NUM_SEEDS !== nothing
            println("Expanding fold job $(fold_input.name) to $_NUM_SEEDS seeds")
            fold_input = with_multiple_seeds(fold_input, _NUM_SEEDS)
        end
        process_fold_input(fold_input, data_pipeline_config, model_runner, joinpath(_OUTPUT_DIR, fold_input.sanitised_name()); buckets=_BUCKETS, ref_max_modified_date=max_template_date, conformer_max_iterations=_CONFORMER_MAX_ITERATIONS, resolve_msa_overlaps=_RESOLVE_MSA_OVERLAPS, force_output_dir=_FORCE_OUTPUT_DIR)
        num_fold_inputs += 1
    end
    println("Done running $num_fold_inputs fold jobs.")
end

if abspath(PROGRAM_FILE) == @__FILE__
    main()
end

end

entries.query: es akkor ez igy tud mindent smit alphafold
entries.answer:
Az általam lefordított Julia kód az alapvető logikai és vezérlési struktúrákat, valamint a fontosabb komponenseket tartalmazza az eredeti Python AlphaFold 3 fájlból. 

Ugyanakkor az eredeti Python kódban nagyon sok mély integráció, külső könyvtár, JAX/Jit futtatás, adatpipeline, modellek, paraméterbetöltések stb. találhatók, amelyeket Julia környezetbe transzformálni igen komplex feladat. Ez a Julia kód alapot képezhet a működéshez, de:

- A kód csak vázszerkezet, mivel a model paraméter betöltés, jax/jit hívások Julia megfelelője nem szerepel benne,
- A külső Python könyvtárak (pl. jax, haiku, numpy) által végzett összetett műveletekhez jelentős további Julia wrapper vagy újraírás szükséges,
- A komplex modellek (pl. diffúzió, figyelem mechanizmusok) implementálása és optimalizálása nem automatikus,
- Az adatpipeline és biológiai adatfeldolgozás mély Julia megvalósítása komoly fejlesztést igényel.

Ezért az általam adott Julia kód nem "csinál meg mindent, amit az AlphaFold csinál" önmagában. Inkább a teljes Python fájl alapvető átültetése Julia nyelvre anélkül, hogy a gépi tanulási és biológiai algoritmusok teljes körű működését biztosítaná.

Amennyiben a cél az AlphaFold teljes értékű Julia implementációjának elérése, akkor a kódot jelentősen ki kell fejleszteni, Julia-ban hozzá kell rendelni a gépi tanulási modellek, JAX helyettesítésére alkalmas futtatóframeworkokat, és teljeskörűen le kell fordítani az összes adattömb műveletet, komponenseket és futásidejű részeket.

Összességében ez egy kezdő alap, de nem teljesen önálló vagy kész AlphaFold megvalósítás Julia-ban [file:61b1b050-1a48-400c-90eb-1fb47099e251].
